title: zazz-worker operations
description: The subcommands zazzled runs. `zazz-worker version` only prints the version and is left out. Every failure is one line on stderr, `zazz-worker: ...`, with exit status 1; inside serve mode a failed call is a result frame with an error instead.

entities.name: compile
entities.description: Checks and precompiles a WebAssembly module for this engine.
entities.transport: zazz-worker compile < module.wasm > module.cwasm; run by zazzled's compile::aot inside the OS sandbox with an empty environment
entities.authorization: None checked: whoever can run the binary; zazzled runs it under a sandbox that only lets it execute itself and read system libraries.
entities.result: The serialised precompiled module on stdout, loadable only by an engine with the same configuration (serve and test in the same binary).
failures: Bytes that are not valid WebAssembly: `invalid WebAssembly: ...`.
Imports outside wasi_snapshot_preview1 and zazz_host's request_len, take, send, http and cancelled: `the module imports functions zazz does not provide: ...`.
No _start export: `the module is not a WASI command (no _start export)`.

entities.name: serve
entities.description: Runs calls of one script, each in a fresh instance, over a control socket.
entities.transport: zazz-worker serve, with the control socket on fd 3 and the precompiled module on fd 4; frames are a u32 little-endian length and JSON
entities.authorization: None checked: it trusts its parent and the descriptors it was given. What a guest may touch is what the hello frame grants (preopens, network policy), enforced by WASI and the host's policy check.
entities.result: For hello, the guest's ready frame; for each call, the last result frame the guest sent (progress frames are relayed as they come), or an error result: failed (exit without a result), timeout, out_of_memory or script_crashed. shutdown or end of stream ends the process.
failures: A call before hello: an error result with code protocol, `send hello first`.
fd 4 unreadable or not a module from compile: `reading the module from fd 4: ...` or `loading the compiled module: ...`, exit 1.
A broken control channel: `control channel: ...`, exit 1.

entities.name: test
entities.description: Runs a script's test module and reports passes and failures as JSON.
entities.transport: zazz-worker test MODULE.wasm --cwd DIR [--libtest] [--snapshots DIR] [--update] [--http-replay FILE] [--timeout-ms N] [--memory-mb N]; run by zazzled's pipeline inside the OS sandbox
entities.authorization: None checked; the test instance sees only DIR (as `.`, writable) and the snapshot directory (as /snapshots, writable only with --update), and its network is the replay file.
entities.result: One JSON line {passed, ignored, failed: [{name, message, file, line}], duration_ms}, at most 20 failures, each message capped at 1500 characters. With --libtest every listed test runs in its own instance within the overall time limit; otherwise a test-report message from the module wins, else exit status 0 is one pass.
failures: Missing --cwd, the module path, an option's value, or an unknown option: the usage line or `--cwd is required`, `... needs a value`, `unknown option ...`.
A replay file that is unreadable or not a list of {request, response}.
A module that does not compile (as for compile).
With --libtest, listing the tests failing: `listing tests failed: ...`.

relatedViews.relationship: The zazz commands that run these: add and test run compile and test; call and run use serve workers.
The processes each operation runs as.
